name: Metanite
flavor_text: Rayeels predecessor, Dragonite can accelerate energy to your Pokemon, while Metagross can discard them to do big damage! Metagross also helps with its great consistency engine.

name: Politoed
flavor_text: Set up a big Politoed ex, and then switch into fossils to abuse the fact that they don't give up prizes! Be careful of Pow! Hand Extension, and hit and run your way to victory!

name: Rock Lock
flavor_text: The original spread deck! Set up Dark Tyranitar to spread damage to basic Pokemon. If they evolve, Dark Ampharos punishes them with more damage, and then use can ATM Rock to devolve them and do it all over again!

name: Empoleon Raichu
flavor_text: Empoleon serves as both a draw engine and an extremely efficient attack that ramps with a large bench! Miltank helps to attack while you set up your board, and Raichu can hit for weakness on Yveltal or opposing Empoleon. Dusknoir is helpful if you aren't taking big knock outs, so you can move the damage however you need to keep swinging!

name: Fairy Box
flavor_text: An unexpected Worlds finisher, attach fairy energy and move it however you want with Aromatisse. Use this to move energy off before using Max Potion for free! Mega Kangaskhan does consistent damage for little energy, and its big HP lets it keep swinging through damage!

name: Tool Drop
flavor_text: Use Sigilyph to hold up to 4 tools before giving your Trubbish a Plasma Badge to attach an extra energy with Colress Machine to swing for huge damage early on! Masquerain even lets you switch your tools around, picking the right tool for the job at hand!

name: Yveltal Garbodor
flavor_text: Yveltal is one of the best attackers in the history of the game, ramping up damage extremely quickly for its Evil Ball attack. Set up Garbodor to lock your opponent out of abilities while accelerating even more energy with Dark Patch.

name: Turbo Pikachu
flavor_text: Want to play the Lost Zone enguiune without those pesky Comfeys? This is the deck for you! Use battle compressor to send Prism Star cards to the lost zone, and use Trumbeak to quickly ramp to 7 cards so you can use Mirage Gate to power up Piikachu or Raikou!
